mapper.insert: INSERT INTO goods (goods_id, user_id, goods_desc, price, original_price, tags, is_deleted) VALUES (#{goodsId}, #{userId}, #{goodsDesc}, #{price}, #{originalPrice}, #{tags}, #{isDeleted})
mapper.select: SELECT g.goods_id AS g_goods_id, g.user_id, u.user_name, g.goods_desc, g.price, g.original_price, g.tags, gi.id AS img_id, gi.goods_id AS img_goods_id, gi.img_url, gi.img_width, gi.img_height, gi.create_time AS img_create_time FROM goods g LEFT JOIN goods_image gi ON g.goods_id = gi.goods_id LEFT JOIN user u ON g.user_id = u.user_id WHERE g.goods_id = #{id} AND g.is_deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO goods_image (goods_id, img_url, img_width, img_height) VALUES (#{goodsId}, #{imgUrl}, #{imgWidth}, #{imgHeight})
mapper.select: SELECT id AS id, goods_id AS goodsId, img_url AS imgUrl, img_width AS imgWidth, img_height AS imgHeight, create_time AS createTime FROM goods_image WHERE goods_id = #{goodsId} ORDER BY id ASC

SELECT g.goods_id AS g_goods_id, g.user_id, u.user_name, g.goods_desc, g.price, g.original_price, g.tags, gi.id AS img_id, gi.goods_id AS img_goods_id, gi.img_url, gi.img_width, gi.img_height, gi.create_time AS img_create_time FROM goods g INNER JOIN goods_image gi ON g.goods_id = gi.goods_id INNER JOIN user u ON g.user_id = u.user_id WHERE g.is_deleted = 0 and g.user_id!= #{userId}

SELECT g.goods_id AS g_goods_id, g.user_id, u.user_name, g.goods_desc, g.price, g.original_price, g.tags, gi.id AS img_id, gi.goods_id AS img_goods_id, gi.img_url, gi.img_width, gi.img_height, gi.create_time AS img_create_time FROM goods g LEFT JOIN goods_image gi ON g.goods_id = gi.goods_id LEFT JOIN user u ON g.user_id = u.user_id WHERE g.goods_id = #{id} AND g.is_deleted = 0

SELECT g.goods_id AS g_goods_id, g.user_id, u.user_name, g.goods_desc, g.price, g.original_price, g.tags, gi.id AS img_id, gi.goods_id AS img_goods_id, gi.img_url, gi.img_width, gi.img_height, gi.create_time AS img_create_time FROM goods g LEFT JOIN goods_image gi ON g.goods_id = gi.goods_id LEFT JOIN user u ON g.user_id = u.user_id WHERE g.is_deleted = 0 AND (g.goods_desc LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR g.tags LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) and g.user_id!= #{userId}

SELECT g.goods_id AS g_goods_id, g.user_id, u.user_name, g.goods_desc, g.price, g.original_price, g.tags, gi.id AS img_id, gi.goods_id AS img_goods_id, gi.img_url, gi.img_width, gi.img_height, gi.create_time AS img_create_time FROM goods g LEFT JOIN goods_image gi ON g.goods_id = gi.goods_id LEFT JOIN user u ON g.user_id = u.user_id WHERE g.user_id = #{currentUserId} AND g.is_deleted = 0

mapper.select:
SELECT ct.id AS id, ct.goods_id AS goods_id, ct.parent_id AS parent_id, ct.text AS text, ct.picture AS picture, ct.son AS son, ct.create_time AS create_time, ct.good_or_bad AS good_or_bad, ct.user_id AS user_id, U1.avatar AS user_avatar, U1.user_name AS user_name,
ct.reply_user_id AS reply_user_id, U2.avatar AS reply_user_avatar, U2.user_name AS reply_user_name FROM comment_goods AS ct LEFT JOIN user U1 ON U1.user_id = ct.user_id LEFT JOIN user U2 ON U2.user_id = ct.reply_user_id WHERE ct.goods_id = #{goodsId}
